summary.text: Karen Montell is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 54 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working as a small business owner and legislative staffer.

paragraphs.text: Karen Montell graduated from Gardiner Area High School and earned a modeling degree from Barbizon Modeling in 1989.
She was assigned to the Veterans and Legal Affairs Committee in 2023-2024 and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
